decision: Both completed main panels contain regressions and inconclusive cells. No acceptance, resampling, successor candidate or causal attribution follows from these measurements.

diagnostics_after_review.independent_review: Read-only review verified all original qualification fields unchanged, four exact profile calls and scientific fingerprints, accounting/hashes, source-derived allocations, actual-binary bounds checks and the stated sample predicates. No additional native calls.
limitations: Single instrumented calls are diagnostic evidence, not timing comparisons or causal effect estimates.
CPU samples include harness parsing and serialization; waiting frames and recursive inclusions must not be counted repeatedly.
The Linux task-clock:u event excludes kernel time, including some allocation/page-fault cost.
Mac desktop and exact-bound Claude activity remain retained; the sampled observer does not prove quietness.
The separately held back-substitution patch remains outside the candidate.

linux.interpretation: Dense cross-tab accumulation is the leading setup target. For these unweighted categorical pairs, source inspection gives a correction-vector allocation total of 20.88 MB plus finishing sweeps; this is not a measured peak-memory delta. Exact integer counts through 2^53 do not require those corrections; a guarded dense-only bypass can preserve arithmetic and the original dense/sparse choice.
linux.method: perf 4.18 task-clock:u at 4000 Hz, 16 KiB DWARF stacks, strict frequency; permission/unwind probe before plugins. Whole-node omp28/num_proc28 reservation, four estimator workers.

mac.interpretation: Observation accumulation is the leading target. Candidate fixed_tree has 1779 nonrecursive-inclusive/1763 exclusive samples, including inlined leaf work; this does not identify recursion or Rayon as the cause. Static disassembly shows two row bounds checks per hot-loop iteration, motivating a slice specialization preserving every sum and tree.
mac.method: sample at nominal 1 ms, -mayDie, maximum 120 s; permission probe on sleep before either plugin; one fixed-order invocation per arm.
mac.selected_operator_bucket_definition: Worker-thread stack union containing ::gather::, ::scatter::, ::fused::, ::apply_adjoint:: or ::apply_fused_update::, counted once per sample. Excludes generic DesignOperator::apply self/other descendants; including those adds 41 candidate samples.

background_noise.limitations: CPU delta includes adjacent matched samples only; first sightings, gaps and between-sample activity are not fully measured. No idle claim or timing exclusion follows from these counters.
background_noise.policy: Exactly bound Claude processes are retained measurement noise; no exclusion or retry.

mac.uncertainty: One-sided .025 bounds conditional on independent unit scores with a common median; no simultaneous interval claim.

method.block: Two calls per actual artifact in mirrored order; geometric mean within each arm.
method.bounds: One-sided alpha .025 order-statistic bounds; conditional common-median/independent-unit assumptions, no simultaneous interval guarantee.
method.independent_recalculation: All block scores, bounds, classifications, role aliases, seeded orders, fixed-worker fingerprints and cross-worker/host discrete signatures recomputed from stored results. Bounds/classifications and stored block scores agree exactly; independently recomputing geometric means on Mac has at most 4.45e-16 seconds difference for one Linux block (two aliased comparison roles), retained in each panel's roundoff record.
method.linux_unit: Median of two block excesses on each of six distinct accounted physical hosts.
method.mac_unit: Six mirrored blocks on one Mac; desktop/recorded Claude activity retained.
method.threshold: candidate minus baseline minus max(5% baseline, 0.001 seconds)

payload_format.integrity: SHA256 covers canonical UTF-8 decoded JSON: sort_keys=True,separators=(",",":"),allow_nan=False.
payload_format.retention: Every actual call is retained, including warmups, all adverse timings, order, component timers, RSS, monotonic boundaries, solver rows and scientific fingerprint. The payload also retains each cell's scientific snapshot hashes, discrete signatures and observed Within work.
payload_format.seconds: Scored complete native timer NATIVE_SECONDS; native_s is a separate runtime component.
payload_format.solver_rows: Exact retained solver matrix per call; columns are defined in crates/fereg-plugin/src/result.rs.
payload_format.warmup: block = -1; position is within warmup or block.
